rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Runs an explicit HTTP/HTTPS man-in-the-middle proxy that captures requests and responses, lets you modify traffic in-flight (headers, bodies, mock responses, URL rewrites, drops), and supports upstream proxy chaining via SOCKS4/5, HTTP, HTTPS, and PAC. Captures and spoofs TLS fingerprints (JA3/JA4/JA3S) using curl-impersonate in Docker/Podman. Ships interceptors to route Chrome, CLI tools, Docker containers, and Android devices through the proxy, with a DevTools bridge for combined browser automation and wire-level inspection. Includes persistent session recording, HAR import/export, and session replay.
